employmentCountyAge22.citation: Census ACS B23001 age-category boundary from https://api.census.gov/data/2019/acs/acs5/groups/B23001.json; technical data crosswalk, not an actor decision threshold.

employmentCountyAge62.citation: Census ACS B23001 age-category boundary from https://api.census.gov/data/2019/acs/acs5/groups/B23001.json; technical data crosswalk, not an actor decision threshold.

activityMinimumReferenceAge.citation: BLS ATUS 2025 Table 3 civilian-population reference begins at age 15; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t03.htm.

srrsMaximumUnits.citation: Holmes TH, Rahe RH. The Social Readjustment Rating Scale. Journal of Psychosomatic Research 11(2):213-218, 1967, Table 3 life change units. Death of a spouse anchors the scale at 100 units.

srrsDeathOfCloseFamilyMember.citation: Holmes TH, Rahe RH. The Social Readjustment Rating Scale. Journal of Psychosomatic Research 11(2):213-218, 1967, Table 3 life change units. Item 5, death of a close family member: 63 units.

srrsFamilyMemberHealthChange.citation: Holmes TH, Rahe RH. The Social Readjustment Rating Scale. Journal of Psychosomatic Research 11(2):213-218, 1967, Table 3 life change units. Item 11, change in health of a family member: 44 units.

lifeEventStressScale.citation: Converts a life-change-unit share into the core2 stress impulse; P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: Life change units rank event readjustment, not the stress signal's scale; no bound on this conversion has been identified.

lifeEventMoodScale.citation: Converts a life-change-unit share into the core2 mood impulse; P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: Life change units rank event readjustment, not the mood signal's scale; no bound on this conversion has been identified.

driveCauseHalfLifeDays.citation: Half-life of a drive's pull without new events or acts. Starting value one year: prolonged grief disorder is first diagnosable twelve months after a loss (DSM-5-TR, 2022). P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured persistence of event-born causes exists; the twelve-month grief window is context, not a bound.

driveGrudgeHalfLifeDays.citation: Half-life of a drive's pull without new events or acts. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured persistence of interpersonal grudges in a comparable unit has been identified.

driveProtectFamilyHalfLifeDays.citation: Half-life of a drive's pull without new events or acts. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured persistence of protective family motivation after a family health event has been identified.

driveStatusHalfLifeDays.citation: Half-life of a drive's pull without new events or acts. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured persistence of status ambition after a setback has been identified.

driveCallingHalfLifeDays.citation: Half-life of a drive's pull without new events or acts. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured persistence of vocational callings after a formative event has been identified.

driveActReinforcement.citation: Share of a drive's unfilled strength that each act on it fills (commitment and consistency), so repeated acts level off below the ceiling of one. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: Commitment-consistency studies report behavior shifts, not a strength unit on this scale.

perceptionTraitWeight.citation: Weight of each relevant trait on how heavily a perception channel counts. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No instrument-matched bound links these trait scores to event salience.

perceptionClosenessWeight.citation: Extra attention per unit of recorded relationship level with the event's subject. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured bound in this relationship unit has been identified.

perceptionRoleSubject.citation: Attention weight when the event happened to the person. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: Role weights are relative prototype assumptions with no measured bounds.

perceptionRoleFamily.citation: Attention weight when the event happened to a recorded relative. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: Role weights are relative prototype assumptions with no measured bounds.

perceptionRoleHousehold.citation: Attention weight when the event happened to a household member who is not recorded family. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: Role weights are relative prototype assumptions with no measured bounds.

perceptionRoleAcquaintance.citation: Attention weight when the event happened to someone the person knows. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: Role weights are relative prototype assumptions with no measured bounds.

perceptionRoleWitness.citation: Attention weight for a person who witnessed or was told of an event without another recorded tie. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: Role weights are relative prototype assumptions with no measured bounds.

driveShareHours.citation: Time a person spends telling someone about their cause. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No ATUS category isolates conversations about a cause.

causeShareImpulseScale.citation: Stress and mood impulse a listener receives per unit of the teller's drive strength. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured bound for secondhand distress on this scale has been identified.

donateHours.citation: Time spent making one donation. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No ATUS category isolates making a donation.

donationLivingCostDays.citation: One donation equals this many days of the donor's own recorded living cost. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: Annual household giving surveys report yearly totals, not per-gift amounts in days of living cost.

volunteerHours.citation: Hours of one volunteering session for a cause group. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No volunteering-session duration source has been read into the repository yet.

driveConfrontHours.citation: Time spent confronting the person a grudge is held against. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured duration for interpersonal confrontations has been identified.

grudgeRelationshipChange.citation: Relationship level lost on each confrontation. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured bound in this relationship unit has been identified.

confrontImpulse.citation: Stress and mood impulse the confronted person receives. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured bound for this impulse on the core2 affect scale has been identified.

responseCarryOnFit.citation: How strongly a perceived event pushes a person toward carrying on with ordinary life and grieving privately, before their traits lean them; carrying on is the default response. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: The share of bereaved or harmed people who take up a cause is an outcome target for the whole decision, not a bound on this fit.

responseDriveFit.citation: How strongly a perceived event pushes toward forming a drive (a cause, grudge, protective resolve, ambition or calling) before traits lean the person; below the carry-on fit so that only leaning traits form drives. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: The share of bereaved or harmed people who take up a cause is an outcome target for the whole decision, not a bound on this fit.

responseTraitLeanGain.citation: How much a person's trait lean toward a response's act kinds (the shared trait-act table) scales the event's push toward it. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No instrument-matched bound links trait-act lean to response choice after life events.

responseAgencyTurnAge.citation: Age at which a person's capacity to form a lasting drive of their own from an event is half of an adult's, rising smoothly (logistic) around it; starting value near the ages when adolescents form durable civic identities and two years below the age of majority. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: Developmental studies describe identity formation across adolescence, not a measured midpoint for event-born drives.

responseAgencyWidthYears.citation: Width in years of the smooth rise in drive-forming capacity around the turn age. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured width for this rise has been identified.

responseCarryOnBaseline.citation: Ordinary life's own pull toward carrying on, independent of the event; a weak event or a person with little agency leaves life as it was. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: The share of bereaved or harmed people who take up a cause is an outcome target for the whole decision, not a bound on this baseline.

driveStrengthScale.citation: How quickly a response's urgency fills a drive toward its ceiling of one: strength rises as one minus the unfilled share times e to the minus urgency times this scale, so drives stay on the same unit as needs. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: No measured bound links event urgency to the strength of a resulting drive.

driveRetireStrength.citation: Strength below which a faded drive stops being rewritten each day; its effect on choices is already negligible and it rejoins if a new event renews the topic. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: A storage floor for speed, not a behavioral quantity; no empirical bound applies.

driveTraceRetention.citation: Most recent decision and act traces the drives module keeps in memory for observers; counts are always exact. P10 prototype starting value; no direct source for this coefficient. Calibration against P9 life replays and bereaved/activist cohort spreads is pending and blocks release.

spread.reason: A memory budget for developer traces, not a behavioral quantity; no empirical bound applies.
